name: Antony Turner
bio: Antony brings around 30 years of experience in financial services. His work spans organisational transformation, technology infrastructure, security and delivery, combining operating experience with a focus on how organisations adapt.

name: Kieran Ayres
bio: Kieran is completing a DPhil in Statistics at Oxford, developing Bayesian inference methods for epidemiology and computational biology. He previously studied health data analytics and machine learning at Imperial and worked in data science at Accenture.

name: Sophie Fischer
bio: Sophie is completing a DPhil in Computer Science at Oxford. Her work includes computer science research and collaboration with the Oxford Law Faculty on AI in trademark law. She also co-founded the carbon capture startup Cequestre.

name: Bella Raja
bio: Bella is completing a DPhil at the Oxford Internet Institute, examining the social and environmental implications of AI hardware and infrastructure. Her background spans science, technology and society at Stanford and the social science of the internet at Oxford.

name: Orla Hogan
bio: Orla is completing a DPhil in History at Oxford, following a BA and MPhil at Cambridge. She brings experience in strategic communications, crisis management and research into corporate practices in financial services.

name: Emilie Ouwerx
bio: Emilie studied the Social Science of the Internet at Oxford, covering AI regulation, algorithmic bias and digital sovereignty. Her experience includes work on decentralised cloud infrastructure and sustainable risk pool design.

name: Oakem Kyne
bio: Oakem is completing a DPhil in Biology at Oxford, studying how bacterial pathogens evolve and adapt to antibiotics. His work draws on genetic epidemiology, phylogenetics and machine learning.
